name: HC04: Active pre-ART with advanced HIV disease
description: Clients active on pre-ART with confirmed advanced HIV disease at end of quarter
creator: 82f18b44-6814-11e8-923f-e9a88dcb533f
configJson:
{"version": 1, "themeUuid": "fce32056-826f-11f1-b08c-f4053e2709b9", "conditions": [], "sqlPreview": "SELECT DISTINCT art.client_id AS patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card art
INNER JOIN mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary s ON art.client_id = s.client_id
WHERE art.encounter_date >= :startDate AND art.encounter_date < :endDate
  AND art.advanced_disease_status IN ("Suspected Advanced Disease", "Confirmed Advanced Disease CD4 <200", "Confirmed Advanced Disease-Pos TB", "Confirmed Advanced Disease - WHO Stage 3/4")
  AND (s.baseline_regimen_start_date IS NULL OR s.baseline_regimen_start_date >= :endDate);", "themeConfig": {"fields": [{"key": "client", "expr": "client_id", "type": "number", "label": "Client"}], "conditions": [], "dateColumn": "encounter_date", "sourceTable": "mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card", "locationColumn": null, "patientIdColumn": "client_id"}}
sqlTemplate:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT art.client_id) AS total
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card art
INNER JOIN mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary s ON art.client_id = s.client_id
WHERE art.encounter_date >= :startDate AND art.encounter_date < :endDate
  AND art.advanced_disease_status = "Yes"
  AND (s.baseline_regimen_start_date IS NULL OR s.baseline_regimen_start_date >= :endDate)
;
